purpose: Find the weakest arc-length prior whose Fig. 6 non-uniqueness is narrower than the saved 24-start worst-case benchmark without sacrificing fit quality.
pilot_rule: Advance the weakest strength with delta unpenalized chi2 <= 1, stationary closures, positive transform, and six-start Fig. 6 q16-q84 excursions below the benchmark for u and d.
expansion_rule: Expand the selected strength to all 24 independent old-basin initializations and require split-half and bootstrap endpoint stability before final propagation.
